system.description:
The refined court-fencing of Eltor: every fight a performance, every wound a statement. It is learned too in Holfast's halls and among the high elves of Myllnoris.

  • Reshapes: Opening Flourish.
  • Every Move a Statement: Opening Flourish applies to your first two hits in each encounter, not just the first.
    • 9th level: Opening Flourish applies to your first hit in each round.
  • Court Bearing: Advantage on Persuasion and Performance checks in formal settings, and on checks to impress nobles at court.
